-- Atomic dedupe: insert the key, or refresh it only if the last notification
-- was more than 10 minutes ago. Concurrent alerts for the same key wait on the
-- row lock, so only one of them can ever be "new".
WITH sent AS (
  INSERT INTO dedupe_window (key, last_sent) VALUES ($1, now())
  ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET last_sent = now()
    WHERE dedupe_window.last_sent < now() - interval '10 minutes'
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sent) AS is_new;

-- Write one audit row. The whole record is passed as a single JSON parameter.
INSERT INTO alert_log (alert_id, alert_time, rule_id, level, description, agent, srcip, srcuser,
                       country, isp, mitre, score, severity, reasons, action)
SELECT alert_id, alert_time, rule_id, level, description, agent, srcip, srcuser,
       country, isp, mitre, score, severity, reasons, action
FROM jsonb_to_record($1::jsonb) AS r(
  alert_id text, alert_time text, rule_id text, level int, description text, agent text,
  srcip text, srcuser text, country text, isp text, mitre jsonb, score int,
  severity text, reasons jsonb, action text);
